tagline: Providing cloud-based IT solutions and digital transformation services in Hong Kong
hero_kpi_rationale: Revenue of $950 million in 2025, reflecting the group's revenue base in technology services across Asia, with growing exposure to cloud solutions and AI automation services.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total sales generated by the company across all service lines.
kpis.description: Revenue decreased from HK$12.4 billion in 2024 to HK$7.4 billion (US$950.5M) in 2025, primarily driven by lower system development, NFT, web/mobile application development and AI-OCR revenues.
kpis.signal: Significant revenue decline from prior year due to weak macroeconomic environment in Hong Kong and customer hesitation on IT investments.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deduction of direct costs of service delivery.
kpis.description: Calculated as (Gross profit / Revenue) = HK$3,638M / HK$7,396M = 49.2% for FY2025. Service mix impacts margin profile, with AI-OCR services generating higher margins than traditional system development.
kpis.signal: Gross margin of approximately 49% calculated from reported cost of revenue, indicating service-based business model with labor intensity.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit as a percentage of revenue, reflecting operational efficiency.
kpis.description: Operating loss of HK$56.99 billion includes HK$43.3M in share compensation and HK$1.08B in listing expenses, resulting in reported margin of -770.9%. Excluding these items, adjusted operating performance would be substantially different.
kpis.signal: Deeply negative operating margin reflects significant one-time charges including share compensation and listing expenses, making reported metric unrepresentative of operational performance.

kpis.name: Staff Costs (% of Total Costs)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total operating and cost of revenue expenses attributable to staff compensation.
kpis.description: For years ended September 30, 2023, 2024, and 2025, staff costs and director remuneration accounted for 49.38%, 56.01%, and 38.82% respectively. Decline reflects workforce adjustment to market conditions.
kpis.signal: Staff costs decreased significantly as proportion of total costs in FY2025 (38.82%) compared to FY2024 (56.01%), reflecting cost control measures following revenue decline.

kpis.name: R&D Investment
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue invested in research and development activities.
kpis.description: Company maintains steady R&D commitment focused on AI-OCR services, Neural Sense platform development, and advanced automation solutions for enterprise customers.
kpis.signal: Consistent R&D investment of approximately 8.5% of revenue supports continued innovation in AI-OCR and software development services despite revenue pressures.

kpis.name: Customer Concentration - Top 3
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue derived from the three largest customers.
kpis.description: Top three customers accounted for 31.53%, 26.51%, and 8.46% of revenue in FY2025 (total 66.50%), compared to 21.04%, 18.67%, and 12.31% in FY2024 (total 52.02%). Increase reflects customer base contraction during weak economic period.
kpis.signal: High customer concentration increased in FY2025 (66.5%) from FY2024 (52.02%), representing elevated revenue risk from customer dependence.

kpis.name: Revenue - System Development
kpis.explanation: Revenue from custom system development and software solutions services.
kpis.description: System development represents the largest service line but experienced substantial decline reflecting reduced enterprise technology spending during period of economic uncertainty in Hong Kong.
kpis.signal: Largest revenue segment declined significantly, falling from HK$5.9B in FY2024 to HK$4.2B (US$534.9M) in FY2025 due to customer caution.

kpis.name: Revenue - AI-OCR Services
kpis.explanation: Revenue from AI-powered optical character recognition and document processing services.
kpis.description: AI-OCR development services, identified as higher-margin automated service offering, experienced dramatic revenue decline reflecting postponed customer projects and capital budget constraints.
kpis.signal: AI-OCR segment collapsed from HK$807.9M in FY2024 to HK$195.8M (US$25.2M) in FY2025, indicating severe market headwinds for automated services despite strategic importance.

risks.title: Dependence on a limited number of major customers
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly identified in Item 3.D with strong language ("material adverse effect"). Central position in the list of business risks. Revenue concentration mentioned as structural dependency. Stable trend but high weight for a technology SME.

risks.title: Concentration of critical suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly stated ("concentration of suppliers", "few major suppliers"). Medium-high intensity language ("material adverse effect"). Structural parallel with customer dependency. Significant weight for technology supply chain.

risks.title: System and data security risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly detailed ("system and data security risks", "security breaches"). Very intense language ("materially adversely affect"). Central in business risks. Critical for an IT solutions and digital services company. Implicit upward trend (cybersecurity rising).

risks.title: Critical defects in IT and OCR solutions
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly stated ("serious errors, defects, security vulnerabilities or bugs"). High intensity language ("adversely affected"). Critical for a software solutions company. Central in business risks. High weight for product quality.

risks.title: Risk of customer rejection of UAT testing
risks.score_rationale: IT project-specific risk ("user acceptance test"). Medium intensity language ("adversely affected"). Reflects unpredictable project cycles mentioned elsewhere. Moderate weight but direct impact on revenue recognition.

risks.title: Evolving regulatory landscape for NFT services
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly identified ("highly evolving regulatory landscape"). High intensity language ("materially adversely affect"). Mentioned twice (general risks and securities law compliance risks). Upward trend: NFT regulation rapidly evolving. Growing weight for this business line.

risks.title: Inability to develop and integrate AI-OCR technologies
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly stated ("Development and incorporation of our AI technologies... may not be successful"). Medium-high intensity language. Reflects dependency on technological innovation. High weight for product differentiation and future competitiveness.

risks.title: Dependence on CEO and key management team
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly stated ("rely on our CEO and our key management", "loss of key team members"). High intensity language ("severely disrupted"). Relevant for a technology SME with limited history. Significant weight for operational continuity.

ai_positioning.summary: ATGL integrates AI capabilities progressively through AI-OCR services and Neural Sense platform development. Company maintains strategic focus on AI-powered automation and predictive analytics despite near-term revenue headwinds from weak macroeconomic environment in Hong Kong.
evidence: Dedicated AI-OCR services business line with automated, high-margin delivery model
Investment in Neural Sense platform for advanced automation solutions
Continued R&D investment at 8.5% of revenue focused on AI and automation technologies
Historical mention of AI applications in enterprise service delivery
